verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's official docs detail DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation, Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and DLAA on RTX 5090/50-series, plus broad game rollout via the NVIDIA app supporting hundreds of titles. Independent review (Tom's Hardware) confirms these features work in practice, though it flags marketing caveats around Multi Frame Generation's input latency implications. Missing for 10: independent per-game compatibility list/count and more third-party benchmarking corroboration beyond one review.
